verdict.rationale: Raygun documents a Crash Reporting export feature (export all or selected error groups) and CSV exports aligned with filters, showing some data portability, but there is no evidence of a full account-wide export covering APM, RUM, and other modules in open formats, and no documented API/OpenAPI spec (probes return 404) that would enable complete self-service data extraction. missing for 10: full-account data export beyond error groups, documented open API/schema for export, evidence of exporting APM/RUM/user data, independent confirmation of format openness.
